ns2:course.label: Ballet III
ns2:course.description: Intermediate level of Ballet technique for non-dance majors. Course is a continuation and development of the skills in DANC 108. May be repeated to a maximum of 8 hours. Prerequisite: Two semesters of DANC 108 or equivalent or consent of instructor. For non-dance majors.
ns2:course.courseSectionInformation: May be repeated to a maximum of 8 hours. Prerequisite: Two semesters of DANC 108 or equivalent or consent of instructor. For non-dance majors.
ns2:course.sectionRegistrationNotes: Not intended for Dance or Dance major(s).
ns2:course.classScheduleInformation: Written assignments and concert attendance is required.
